tools.name: list_hotels
tools.description: List a bounded page of non-sensitive hotel metadata in the authenticated Hotelumo organization. Addresses, phone numbers, channel credentials, payment configuration, reminder configuration, and guest data are excluded.

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description: Get safe operational metadata for one organization-owned hotel. Contact details, addresses, integrations, credentials, payment configuration, reminders, and guest data are never returned.

tools.name: get_hotel_availability
tools.description: Review bounded, non-person-linked room-type availability and prices for one tenant-owned hotel and a stay of at most 30 nights. Amounts are minor currency units. Guest records, reservations, room assignments, access data, notes, payments, channel references, photos, free-text descriptions, and crede

tools.name: get_hotel_schedule_summary
tools.description: Count tenant-owned reservations and active stays by UTC day for one hotel over at most 31 days. Returns aggregate operational counts only—never reservation or allocation identifiers, individual stay records, guest data, room assignments, notes, documents, payments, access data, channel references, o

tools.name: list_room_types
tools.description: List a bounded page of room-type inventory metadata in the authenticated organization. Photos, public descriptions, rate-plan internals, channel mappings, and credentials are excluded.

tools.name: get_room_type
tools.description: Get bounded inventory metadata for one organization-owned room type. Free-text descriptions, facilities, photos, channel mappings, integrations, credentials, and arbitrary metadata are never returned.

tools.name: list_rooms
tools.description: List a bounded page of physical room status metadata in the authenticated organization. Reservation, occupant, guest, access-control, and channel data are excluded.

tools.name: list_rate_plans
tools.description: List a bounded page of rate-plan pricing configuration for one organization-owned hotel. Channel-manager mappings, integration metadata, and credentials are excluded.

tools.name: list_daily_rates
tools.description: List the per-day price and stay restrictions of one organization-owned rate plan over a date range of at most 90 days. Guest, payment, channel, credential, and arbitrary metadata are excluded.

tools.name: list_extras
tools.description: List a bounded page of the active add-on / extra-service catalog in the authenticated organization. Guest charges, folio data, display colors, and credentials are excluded.

tools.name: show_hotel_overview
tools.description: Render a bounded tenant-scoped operational snapshot for one Hotelumo hotel. Reservation counts cover an aggregate next-seven-UTC-day sample and never expose individual stays.
